_doc: God layer stills (CONTRACT §15.6–15.8): the hand, creatures, disasters, weather, aurora, eclipse. Each scene is staged by its script (lookdev god commands + window.__GENESIS_FX__.advance(s) to move the FX clock, which otherwise only runs with sim time). Run: node _harness/shots.mjs _harness/specs/god.json

shots.name: god-hand-village
script: document.getElementById('boot')?.remove(); G.ui_.closeAll(); const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true; const p = G.poi('town');
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (26 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 16, yaw: 0, pitch: -14, fov: 50, hour: 16 });

await G.frames(1); const a = G.agents(12).sort((x, y) => x.dist - y.dist).map((x) => x.id); const r = await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand.grab', target: { kind: 'agent', id: a[0] } }); await G.step(1); await G.frames(3);
return { held: [F.fx.hand.heldKind, F.fx.hand.heldId], scale: F.fx.hand.scale };

shots.name: god-hand-close
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = true; const p = G.poi('valley');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.hand', pos: p.pos, alt: 3, alignment: 0.8, pose: 'open', held: null });
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (9 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 5, yaw: 0, pitch: -12, fov: 45, hour: 15 });
await G.frames(3); return { scale: F.fx.hand.scale, pres: F.fx.hand.presence };

shots.name: god-creatures
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = false; const p = G.poi('forest-edge');
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (30 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 5, yaw: 0, pitch: -3, hour: 10.5 });
F.advance(2); await G.frames(2); return F.fx.creatures.count;

shots.name: god-meteor-1-before
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; F.fx.hand.force = false; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'meteor', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.95, bearing: 270, radius: 120 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 3200, tilt: 74, yaw: 0, fov: 55, hour: 17.3 });
F.advance(0.6); await G.frames(2); return [p.lat, p.lon];

shots.name: god-meteor-2-impact
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster.cancel', all: true }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'meteor', pos: p.pos, progress: 1, bearing: 270, radius: 120 });
await G.step(1); await G.frames(1); F.advance(0.5); await G.frames(1);

shots.name: god-volcano-night
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('peak');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'volcano', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5, intensity: 0.6 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 2600, tilt: 62, yaw: 200, fov: 70, hour: 23.5 });
F.advance(20); await G.frames(1); F.advance(4); await G.frames(1);

shots.name: god-tornado
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('farm');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather', kind: 'storm', pos: p.pos, radius: 1400, intensity: 0.8 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'tornado', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5, intensity: 1.1 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', lat: p.lat - (700 / 3000) * 180 / Math.PI, lon: p.lon, alt: 250, yaw: 0, pitch: 6, fov: 75, hour: 16.5 });
F.advance(12); await G.frames(2);

shots.name: god-tsunami
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('coast'); const h = p.heading * Math.PI / 180;
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'tsunami', pos: p.pos, offset: [Math.sin(h) * 950, Math.cos(h) * 950], progress: 0.66, radius: 420, intensity: 1.5 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: p.lat, lon: p.lon, dist: 520, tilt: 74, yaw: p.heading - 20, fov: 60, hour: 10.5 });
F.advance(6); await G.frames(2); return p.heading;

shots.name: god-blizzard-street
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('town');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather', kind: 'blizzard', pos: p.pos, radius: 2500, intensity: 1 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.field', field: 'snow', pos: p.pos, radius: 2500, value: 1 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'town', alt: 2.2, pitch: 3, hour: 11 });
F.advance(8); await G.frames(2); return F.fx.m && F.fx.m.weather.local;

shots.name: god-eclipse
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('valley');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'eclipse', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5, params: { coverage: 0.995 } });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'valley', alt: 40, pitch: 6, fov: 16, sunElevation: 8, faceSun: true });
F.advance(4); await G.frames(2); return { ecl: F.fx.screenState.eclipse, uv: [F.fx.screenState.sunUV.x, F.fx.screenState.sunUV.y], r: F.fx.screenState.sunR };

shots.name: god-aurora-orbit
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('peak');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.star', activity: 1 }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.planet.set', magnetism: 1.2 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.disaster', kind: 'magnetic-storm', pos: p.pos, progress: 0.5 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', lat: -60, lon: 30, dist: 4200, tilt: 30, yaw: 180, hour: 0.5 });
F.advance(30); await G.frames(2); return { level: F.fx.m && F.fx.m.aurora.level, boost: F.fx.auroraBoost.boost, mag: F.fx.view && F.fx.view.planets[0].params.magnetism };

shots.name: god-rain-street
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('town');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather', kind: 'thunderstorm', pos: p.pos, radius: 2500, intensity: 1 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', poi: 'town', alt: 1.8, pitch: 6, hour: 14 });
F.advance(30); await G.frames(2); return { local: F.fx.m && F.fx.m.weather.local, lens: F.fx.screenState.lens };

shots.name: god-miracles
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; const p = G.poi('town');
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' }); await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.weather.clear' });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.miracle.shield', pos: p.pos, radius: 90 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.miracle.heal', pos: p.pos, offset: [140, 40], radius: 70 });
await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.miracle.food', pos: p.pos, offset: [-150, -20], radius: 70 });
await G.step(1); await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', poi: 'town', dist: 420, tilt: 62, hour: 18.2 });
F.advance(1.6); await G.frames(2);

shots.name: god-brush
script: const F = window.__GENESIS_FX__; await G.cmd({ k: 'lookdev.clear' });
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', poi: 'town', dist: 260, tilt: 55, hour: 13 });
const ok = G.ui_.arm('disaster-meteor'); G.ui_.pointer(480, 300); await G.frames(3); return { ok, brush: !!F.fx.brush };
